launch: mvn test -B -o -pl gson -Dtest=com.google.gson.DefaultDateTypeAdapterTest#testNullValue -Dmaven.surefire.debug & g=$!; until grep -qE ':138D [0-9A-F]+:0000 0A' /proc/net/tcp /proc/net/tcp6 2>/dev/null; do grep -q '^State:[[:space:]]*[^Z]' /proc/$g/status 2>/dev/null || exit 1; sleep 1; done; echo 'Listening for transport dt_socket at address: 5005 (the test JVM listens)'; wait
notes: Gold points: the first hunk is a pure insertion at the start of write (point: the statement after it, the synchronized block); the last changes read's token check. points.why: the statement after the inserted null check in write (first hunk): the synchronized formatting block
the changed token check in read (last hunk)
the first assertion of testNullValue (assertNull of fromJson("null"))
